outputs.explanation: Panel A contains only micrographs (MitoTracker, DsRed, GFP, merge images); there is no averaged quantification plot present, so the check does not apply.
The two bar charts (JC-1 relative intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity, n=20) show only mean bars with error bars; no individual data points are overlaid despite averaging 20 replicates per condition.
Panel C is a Western blot image with no averaged/quantification plot, so the check is not applicable.
The bar charts for SDH and COX signal intensity display group means with error bars and sample sizes (n=15-26) but no individual data points are shown.

Panel E shows FACS histograms (cell counts vs TMRM intensity) and a schematic; the histograms are distribution/line plots of raw single-cell data (not averaged summary bar/point plots), so overlaying individual points is not applicable.
